title: Beyond Primitive Bloat: High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting via Coordinate-Convolution Neural Network
abstract: arXiv:2512.12898v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Gaussian Splatting (GS) has revolutionized Novel View Synthesis (NVS) with fast training and real-time rendering, yet pushing its fidelity to arbitrary high levels remains an open challenge. We theoretically explain this barrier by proving that discrete Gaussian representations require an exponentially increasing number of primitives to raise training PSNR, which inevitably triggers optimization issues and validation overfitting. To bypass this scaling limit without primitive bloat, we formulate detail recovery as a continuous neural field over coarse renderings and prove that monotonically reducing approximation risk to zero requires jointly leveraging low-fidelity signals, local neighborhood, and coordinate queries. translated_abstract: 高斯泼溅（GS）以其快速的训练和实时渲染彻底改变了新视角合成（NVS），但将其保真度提升到任意高的水平仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。我们通过证明离散高斯表示需要指数级增长的图元数量才能提升训练PSNR，从理论上解释了这一障碍，这不可避免地引发优化问题和验证集过拟合。为了在不产生图元膨胀的情况下绕过这一扩展极限，我们将细节恢复表述为粗略渲染之上的连续神经场，并证明要将逼近风险单调地降低至零，需要联合利用低保真度信号、局部邻域以及坐标查询。在这一结果的指导下，我们利用现有的坐标卷积神经网络（CCNN）来增强泼溅渲染，该网络将渲染的低保真度信号与2D像素坐标查询进行联合卷积以合成……
tldr: 该论文从理论上证明离散高斯表示存在图元数量指数级增长导致的保真度瓶颈，并提出以坐标卷积神经网络（CCNN）将细节恢复建模为粗渲染之上的连续神经场，从而无需图元膨胀即可实现高保真高斯泼溅。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically proves that discrete Gaussian representations face an exponential primitive-scaling barrier to fidelity, and proposes a Coordinate-Convolution Neural Network (CCNN) that models detail recovery as a continuous neural field over coarse renderings, achieving high-fidelity Gaussian Splatting without primitive bloat.
